events.label: The Summit Challenge (St. Elizabeth, Jamaica)
events.activities: The Summit Challenge, a timed team event in St. Elizabeth, Jamaica, organised by Sight Seers Caribbean Adventures ("Sight Seers"). It includes a climbing relay, laser tag, an ATV ride, a train tour and team games, and travel by coach, including the connector service, between the meeting point and the venue. Some activities are provided by third-party venue operators and guides
bring: Comfortable activewear suited to climbing and laser tag
Snacks, as food stops in the area are limited

clauses.t: I am taking part in {activities}. I understand some activities are provided by third-party operators and guides.

I understand these activities involve physical effort and real risks, including falls, collisions, strains, sprains, cuts, bruises, broken bones, heat and sun exposure, insect bites, and, rarely, serious injury or death. Road and water travel and weather add further risks. I understand these risks cannot be removed completely, even with care, instructions and safety equipment.

I will follow the safety briefing and the instructions of the Sight Seers Team Lead, guides and operators. I will use the equipment provided as shown. I will not take part while under the influence of alcohol or drugs. I will wear suitable clothing and footwear. I will stop an activity and tell someone if I feel unwell or unsafe. I am fit to take part, or I have told the Team Lead about anything that affects that.
I choose to take part and I accept the risks described above.

To the fullest extent the law allows, I release and agree not to hold Sight Seers, its owners, directors, employees, guides, Team Leads, contractors and agents, and the venue, transport and activity operators it works with (together, "the Released Parties"), responsible for any injury, illness, death, loss, or damage to me or my belongings that happens because of my taking part or the travel connected to it, including injury caused by the ordinary negligence of a Released Party. I also agree not to bring a claim for such loss.
This waiver does not limit anyone's liability where the law does not allow it to be limited, including liability for death or personal injury caused by gross negligence or deliberate wrongdoing.

If I am injured or become ill, I allow Sight Seers and the Team Lead to arrange first aid and emergency medical care for me, and I will be responsible for the cost of any treatment or transport that is not paid by someone else. Sight Seers is not a medical provider.
I understand that I am responsible for my own health and accident insurance.
I will take care of equipment I am given. I may be asked to leave an activity, without a refund, if my behaviour puts myself or others at risk.
The information I have given in this form is used to run the event and keep me safe. Sight Seers keeps it only as long as it needs to and does not sell it.
This waiver is governed by the laws of Jamaica.
I have read this waiver, I understand it, and I sign it freely. I am 18 or older.

photoClause: I allow Sight Seers to photograph and film the event and to use images of me to promote its services.
